evidence: We are Gao Kitchen, a San Francisco-based dining experience centered around shared meals and community.
Divan is a restaurant rooted in Turkish tradition, emphasizing communal dining and thoughtful, shareable dishes.
Our space is available for rent by donation to local groups and organizations.
We also host private events in our vibrant restaurant space or the elegant Rose Room.
Our space combines style, creativity, and modern amenities to host corporate events, live music, DJ performances, product launches, and film productions.
We focus on responsible sourcing, thoughtful preparation, and creating a warm atmosphere that brings family and friends together over shared meals.
We host events that celebrate local history, live performance, and community connection.
